_readme: Hand-maintained corrections, applied AFTER generation so a regeneration can never clobber one. Shape: { shows|characters: { <subjectKey>: { <field>: value } } }. A null value SUPPRESSES a fact the source is wrong about. Subject keys are the folded form - franchiseTitleKey for shows, characterNameKey for characters.
_why: Each entry below came out of checking the pack's outside facts against MyAnimeList (2026-10-18). Corrections where the right answer is clear; suppressions where the series moved between web platforms and no single answer is right.
